Kevin Trudeau was sitting with Josh Altman, the Bravo real estate star, in Beverly Hills.

Turns out they grew up a few towns apart in Massachusetts. Kevin's dad was a welder. Josh grew up in Newton - the town where the doctors lived, the one everybody back home assumed was rich.

Josh laughed. He said he thought his family was doing great too - until he moved to Beverly Hills and saw what real money actually looked like.

Even "rich" is relative until you're standing next to the next level of it.

What did you think "rich" meant growing up, and has that number changed?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #moneymindset #richhabits #millionairemindset #successhabits

Kevin Trudeau says most people who buy a course on making money never actually make any - and it's not because the course was bad.

He calls it a counter intention: a block that fights your own goal the moment you set it, the same way wind, drought and birds can kill a seed before it ever grows.

Plant that identical seed in good soil with rain and sun, and it grows almost on its own.

Same seed, same effort - the only difference is what's working against it underneath the surface.

What's the block you think is actually working against your own goals right now?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindsetmatters #wealthmindset

Kevin Trudeau once walked into a seminar thinking he already knew it all - until the speaker opened with: "If you didn't make $10 million last year, sit down and shut up."

Kevin hadn't. The guy had. Point taken - he sat down and actually listened.

He says he's since watched someone go from almost nothing in his accounts to documented bank deposits of over $12.5 million in about eighteen months - numbers pulled straight from the man's own CPA.

The before and after wasn't luck. It was what changed in between.

Who's the person you'd actually sit down and shut up to learn from?
